description: Defines the BanAdmin class for managing banned IP addresses in Drupal, including form building, validation, and submission logic.

classes.name: BanAdmin
classes.description: Form class for managing banned IP addresses, including listing, adding, and deleting bans.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the BanAdmin class with the IP manager service.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the class with dependency injection.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form for listing and adding banned IP addresses.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the IP address input, ensuring it's not already banned, not the user's own IP, and is valid.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission to ban the specified IP address and redirects to the admin page.
